target.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
target.claim: A general-purpose generation recipe combines a pre-trained sequence-to-sequence parametric memory with a dense Wikipedia index accessed by a pre-trained neural retriever.
